# Udo Ezekiel

> Udo Ezekiel is a freelance website designer based in Lagos, Nigeria, helping businesses succeed online. He designs and builds corporate websites, ecommerce stores, landing pages, and eLearning (LMS) platforms, and offers digital marketing services.

## About

- Name: Udo Ezekiel
- Location: Lagos, Nigeria
- Services: corporate website design, ecommerce website design, landing page design, eLearning/LMS websites, digital marketing
- Contact: hello@udoezekiel.dev, WhatsApp +2347067886756
